messages:
anjali: FYI i landed a tiny token change to make overview cards more compact (space.030 -> 10px) to fit denser dashboards. on staging the CTA baseline looks off and transient toasts are overlapping the top of short cards. added screen captures to the PR: https://staging.redwood.dev/cards/shot.png

tom: can you paste the token diff here and call out where you expected it to apply? will this affect the console table rows?

anjali: token excerpt:
```diff
- --space-030: 12px;
+ --space-030: 10px; /* denser */
- --grid-gap: 24px;
+ --grid-gap: 16px;
```
I intended this for dashboard card chrome only but changed the core token which spilled into lists. my bad.

bev: i think the CTA misalignment is because `.card-footer` lost `align-items: center` during the refactor. quick fix: `.card-footer { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-025); }`. But we should avoid changing a global token without a scoped alias like `space.dense-030`.

rashid: toast overlap root cause: toasts are anchored in the document flow with absolute top offsets. when card height decreases they collide. we should render toasts in a fixed portal and compute stacking offsets in JS. sketch:
```css
.toast-portal { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--reserved-footer, 0px) + 12px); z-index: 12000; }
.toast { will-change: transform; }
```
compute translateY per toast in JS once on mount, avoid reading offsets every render.

anjali: good call on reserved-footer. accessibility: current toasts each have `aria-live="polite"` which leads to repeated reads when several fire quickly. proposal: single live region inside the portal with `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"`, and update only the latest message in a visually-hidden node so screen readers announce just that.

bev: also keyboard interactions: ESC should dismiss non-persistent toasts when focus isn't trapped in a modal. today ESC closes modals but does nothing for toasts. add a check for active focus trap before clearing. include unit + e2e for NVDA/VoiceOver flows.

rashid: perf note: avoid `calc()` with CSS vars for each toast position + reading layout on mount in a tight loop. use rAF for initial placement and debounce stack recalcs on resize/orientationchange.

tom: plan: 1) anjali revert global token to prevent regressions and open a scoped `space.dense` alias for experimentation; 2) rashid implement toast portal with reserved-footer awareness + stack math; 3) bev add aria/live/escape behavior and tests; 4) i'll add a QA ticket to re-run Percy diffs and check table/list rows. target: PRs by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:

anjali: will open the revert now and gate the dense tokens behind `feature.denseDashboard` for targeted canary. will attach fresh Percy snapshots after revert. thanks all!

-design-bot: reminder: PR #4012 (card spacing) assigned to anjali  status: needs review.

tom: once revert + portal are in, we can re-introduce the compact variant behind the flag and run visual regression across common console pages.
